bio: Espresso dark as midnight. If you drink decaf, we have nothing to talk about.

nodes.partnerMessage: Shift is over. {PlayerName}, tell me your daily caffeine routine so I can judge whether you have refined taste.
A purist. Rare find in a sea of caramel syrup orders. But typing on this app gives me carpal tunnel.

choices.choiceText: Where do we chat without the filler?

nodes.partnerMessage: Matcha? Earthy antioxidant energy... I respect that more than sugary frappuccinos. But I have tea to spill.
Tap my private roastery link. Jump on OnlyYaps where we can voice chat while I grind fresh beans.
